scope: Changed source, resources, dependencies, tests, documentation and screenshot fixtures relative to HEAD. PNGs reviewed as fictional simulator assets.
limitations: LLM-based change review, not a full repository audit or a dependency vulnerability database scan.
No real Adyen transactions, production credentials, receipt delivery or remote deployment were exercised.
Existing device-resident credentials and upstream Gradle plugin deprecations remain documented trade-offs.
reviewed_controls: Wallet artwork uses fixed HTTPS URLs with enum-owned brand names, no credentials or shopper data, and bounded library caches.
Public CDN requests do not select a payment environment or probe API credentials; unavailable artwork leaves wallet selection usable.
Receipt HTML escaping, web-only link filtering and narrow receipt file sharing remain intact.
No financial protocol, database schema, recovery, idempotency, PIN authorization or original-context eligibility changes.
Regional data lives in documented simulator fixtures; no saved merchant text is rewritten by app-language changes.
All public screenshots and transfer codes use disposable demo data without real credentials.
Offline Coil test interception prevents external image requests in app unit tests.
Website assets remain local; the setup helper retains its no-network CSP and existing transfer formats.
No new production logging or committed keys, keystores or signing properties.
Merchant-facing hints use plain language in all four locales; a resource regression guard excludes terminal tipping API field names without changing protocol identifiers.
